title: Let a person allow a check command set for the whole thread
text: The question before project checks run offers allow and deny. Make it offer the three answers every other permission has: allow once (allow), allow for this thread (allow-thread) and deny. ResolveChatPermission for a check question accepts those three and refuses any other choice with reason permission-not-pending and the next step "Choose allow once, allow for this thread or deny." Allowing for the thread records the approved command set on the thread's check state, in a new nullable field called approved in the contracts: a hash over each enabled check's id, its command and a digest of the script behind it, read from the thread's own copy whichever copy runs. Later runs of the same command set start without a question in every flight mode. A check whose command or script changed since it was turned on still asks, even for an approved set. Without an approval the old rule holds: Balanced asks, and Glide asks only when the thread's permission policy does not cover commands.

checks.name: service
args: --test-name-pattern=checks refuse shell lines, ask before running and run on a merged copy

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout, and the checks ran with a minimal environment and a temporary home.
